free_tier.stated: EUR 14.99/month for VPS Package 1 in Frankfurt: 2 cores on an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X at 4.3 to 5.7 GHz, 4 GB DDR5, 50 GB NVMe Gen4, a 10 Gbps uplink with unlimited bandwidth under a fair-use term, DDoS protection through DataForest.net, one dedicated IPv4 with a custom DNS entry, and free additional IPs on request. Package 2 is EUR 24.99 for 3 cores, 8 GB and 100 GB; Package 3 is EUR 34.99 for 4 cores, 12 GB and 150 GB; Package 4 is EUR 54.99 for 5 cores, 16 GB and 200 GB; Package 5 is EUR 64.99 for 6 cores, 24 GB and 250 GB. The offer thread sells the same first package at EUR 7.50/month with code FIRSTORDER50 and calls that 'this recurring price'.
